steps.description: On identification of a material accounting error, the CFO immediately notifies the Audit Committee.

evidence.quote: the CFO must immediately notify the Audit Committee

steps.description: If the restatement is triggered by fraud or intentional misconduct, the Audit Committee must engage independent outside legal counsel before any restated financials are prepared.

evidence.quote: If the restatement is triggered by fraud or intentional misconduct rather than an inadvertent error, the Audit Committee must engage independent outside legal counsel before any restated financials are prepared or reviewed.

steps.description: Internal Audit quantifies the error and prepares restated financial statements, running in parallel with Legal Counsel review.

evidence.quote: Internal Audit quantifies the error and prepares restated financial statements

steps.description: Legal Counsel assesses disclosure obligations under applicable SEC rules and regulations, running in parallel with Internal Audit.

evidence.quote: Legal Counsel assesses disclosure obligations under applicable SEC rules and regulations

steps.description: External auditors re-review and sign off on the restated financial statements before the Audit Committee may approve them.

evidence.quote: External auditors must re-review and sign off on the restated financial statements before the Audit Committee may approve them

steps.description: The Audit Committee approves the restated financials only after the external auditor re-review is complete.

evidence.quote: The Audit Committee approves the restated financials only after the external auditor re-review is complete

steps.description: The Board of Directors ratifies the restatement after Audit Committee approval and before SEC filing.

evidence.quote: The Board of Directors must ratify the restatement before it is filed with the SEC
The Board ratification must occur after Audit Committee approval

steps.description: The restated financials are filed with the SEC after Board ratification.

evidence.quote: The restated financials are then filed with the SEC
